name: Sendou Yuzuka
source: 2nd lieutenant of the 1st Tactical Armor Regiment in the Imperial Japanese Army/Mainland Defense Force. Serves under Tatsunami Hibiki in the Wardog squad as second-in-command and has served with him in other squads in the past.
